evaluation.silhouette: Modest rectangular table. Reads clearly as furniture but lacks command presence for the main strategic center of the sanctuary.
evaluation.construction: Plain 4-legged wooden table scaled up. Solid ground contact on keep flagstones.
evaluation.approach: Direct south approach from keep courtyard.
evaluation.wyvernClearance: Sheltered inside keep north court; not directly under wyvern landing path.
evaluation.recommendation: Retain core desk form; add map parchment surface, campaign marker tokens, iron trim, and side map chests.

evaluation.silhouette: Compact writing desk. Functionally readable but slightly small relative to player height.
evaluation.approach: Clear east/south approach from keep spine.
evaluation.recommendation: Add open leather-bound wyvern registry ledger, inkwell, quill, and rolled parchment scrolls.

evaluation.silhouette: FATAL: Currently a spiked wooden roadblock/blockade. Completely misrepresents living quarters or troop staging.
evaluation.construction: Crude crossed timber roadblock with spikes.
evaluation.recommendation: Priority Replacement #1: Replace with a timber-and-stone guard post / barracks shelter with canvas lean-to, bunk rolls, weapon rack, and lantern.

evaluation.silhouette: FATAL: Currently an open campfire on the ground. Fails to convey a healing shelter or veterinary care facility.
evaluation.construction: Loose stones in a circle with firewood.
evaluation.recommendation: Priority Replacement #2: Replace with a sheltered healer's awning with herbal drying rack, warm stone hearth, water basin, clean bandages/balms table, and soft straw recovery mat.

evaluation.silhouette: Impressive natural rock cavern entrance. Strong landmark read.
evaluation.construction: Downscaled natural cave mesh. Faceted low-poly shading at entrance.
evaluation.approach: Wide opening facing south-west into care court.
evaluation.recommendation: Remodel cave entrance geometry for smoother rock transitions, add thermal ember hearth inside, straw nesting pads, and carved incubation runes at the arch.

evaluation.silhouette: Broad elevated rock plateau flanked by twin rune stones. Excellent scale for two adult wyverns.
evaluation.construction: Tiered mossy rock platform with flat top.
evaluation.recommendation: Keep geometry; add detailed claw-gripped rock texture, nest indentations, soft heather bedding, and glowing bonding runes.

evaluation.silhouette: FATAL: Reuses the wooden road blockade. Completely ambiguous.
evaluation.recommendation: Priority Replacement #3: Replace with a circular palisade training enclosure with stout wooden posts, leather dummy targets, carcass rack, and hunting horn post.

evaluation.silhouette: Tall mystic standing stone monolith. Forms a strong visual terminus to the central north-south spine.
evaluation.construction: Dressed ancient carved stone with weathered spiral runes.
evaluation.recommendation: Keep as anchor; add wind direction streamers, perimeter marker stones, and subtle updraft particle seam.

evaluation.silhouette: Miniature volcano cone. Thematic idea is clear but the execution feels like a toy volcano sitting on top of the grass.
evaluation.recommendation: Priority Replacement #4: Replace with an engineered dragon-fire target range: heat-treated obsidian deflection wall, iron target baffles, ash pit, and scorched post targets.

evaluation.silhouette: FATAL: A small wooden trail signpost, hard to notice against background trees.
evaluation.wyvernClearance: Transition to rugged highlands edge (10m radius).
evaluation.recommendation: Priority Replacement #5: Replace with an imposing timber-and-stone mountain trailhead archway, waypoint banner, stone mileage cairn, and water trough.

evaluation.silhouette: Stone chimney furnace with integrated forge tools (anvil, quenching trough, grindstone, tool holder). Highly readable.
evaluation.construction: Dressed stone blocks with iron chimney flue.
evaluation.recommendation: Keep core structure; add timber protective lean-to roof, slag pile, scale-plate displays, and dynamic quench smoke.
